{"metadata":{"description":"One-key ClawRouters plugin for DeepSeek Harness: chat, image, video, and web search","id":"gh:1333660413","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-plugin-clawrouters","slug":"ropon/dsh-plugin-clawrouters","topics":["ai-agent","clawrouters","deepseek-harness","dsh-plugin","image-generation","typescript","video-generation","web-search"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"One-key ClawRouters plugin for DeepSeek Harness: chat, image, video, and web search"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-plugin-clawrouters"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 简体中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"ClawRouters for DeepSeek Harness: install one DSH bundle, configure one API key in the Web UI, and u"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"se chat, image generation, video generation, and web search."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## Why this plugin"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"ClawRouters exposes multiple AI capabilities behind one OpenAI-compatible API and one credential. Th"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"is plugin maps those capabilities into DSH's plugin-native seams instead of adding a separate applic"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"gin maps those capabilities into DSH's plugin-native seams instead of adding a separate application:"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"- `clawrouters / auto` — OpenAI-compatible chat route, including image input.
- `clawrouters_image_g"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"enerate` — generates images and stores them as durable DSH image attachments.
- `clawrouters_video_g"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"enerate` — submits and polls a video task, then returns the signed result URL.
- `clawrouters_web_se"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"arch` — returns structured titles, snippets, and source URLs without replacing DSH's existing generi"},{"id":"p7s5","text":"c `web_search` provider."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"Requirements: DeepSeek Harness `0.1.0-rc.6` or newer and pnpm on `PATH`."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"Install the tagged GitHub release into the Web profile:"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"The repository commits its built `lib/` output, so a GitHub installation does not need pnpm `allowBu"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"ilds` or run an install-time build script."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"To try a local checkout during development:"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"## Configure one key"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"1. Open DSH Web or Desktop.
2. Go to **Settings → Models → ClawRouters**.
3. Paste your ClawRouters "},{"id":"p16s2","text":"API key and save.
4. Select **clawrouters / auto** in the conversation model picker."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"The Web UI stores the secret through DSH's credential service under `CLAWROUTERS_API_KEY`; it is not"},{"id":"p17s2","text":" written into `settings.yaml`. The chat route and all three tools resolve that same credential on ev"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"ery call, so key rotation applies without rebuilding the plugin."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"You can also provide the key through the launch environment:"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"This repository is a DSH bundle. `cordis.patch.yml` does two things:"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"1. Adds a `clawrouters` provider profile to DSH's built-in generic `llm-pi-ai` adapter. Reusing its "},{"id":"p22s2","text":"existing `llm-pi-ai` settings namespace makes the stock Models page render the ClawRouters credentia"},{"id":"p22s3","text":"l card—no browser patch or fork is required.
2. Inserts the `dsh-plugin-clawrouters` function plugin"},{"id":"p22s4","text":", which registers the image, video, and search tools into `ctx.tools` and uses `ctx.attachments` whe"},{"id":"p22s5","text":"n that optional service is present."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"The default API base is `https://www.clawrouters.com/api/v1`. Tool deployment defaults can be overri"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"dden in a later profile patch by targeting `id: clawrouters-tools`."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"## Endpoint mapping"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"| Capability | ClawRouters API |"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"| Chat | `POST /chat/completions` via DSH's pi-ai adapter |
| Image | `POST /images/generations` |
|"},{"id":"p27s2","text":" Video | `POST /videos`, compatibility fallback to `POST /videos/generations`, then `GET /videos/{id"},{"id":"p27s3","text":"}` |
| Search | `POST /search` |"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"Every direct provider request includes the DSH attribution `User-Agent` and the bearer credential. I"},{"id":"p28s2","text":"mage URLs are accepted only over HTTP(S), decoded, format-checked, validated by DSH's attachment pol"},{"id":"p28s3","text":"icy, and persisted before the tool result is appended. Video result URLs are restricted to HTTP(S)."},{"id":"p29s1","text":"## Deferred capabilities"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"- **Embeddings / vector search:** ClawRouters can generate embeddings, but useful vector search also"},{"id":"p30s2","text":" needs a store, indexing, metadata filtering, and similarity retrieval. This plugin will add it when"},{"id":"p30s3","text":" DSH has a vector-store seam; returning large float arrays as a chat tool is intentionally avoided.
"},{"id":"p30s4","text":"- **Text to speech / speech to text:** deferred until DSH has durable audio attachments, upload hand"},{"id":"p30s5","text":"ling, and player/recorder UI. Returning base64 audio as text would be expensive and unusable.
- **Du"},{"id":"p30s6","text":"rable video:** DSH currently has no video attachment block, so the plugin returns the provider's sig"},{"id":"p30s7","text":"ned URL rather than copying video bytes into session storage."},{"id":"p31s1","text":"## Development"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"The test suite covers image persistence, video polling, structured search results, authentication he"},{"id":"p33s2","text":"aders, and a bundle-shape smoke check. Built output is committed because DSH supports installing bun"},{"id":"p33s3","text":"dles directly from GitHub."},{"id":"p34s1","text":"## License"},{"id":"p35s1","text":"MIT"}],"truncated":false}
